about: Hand-made rules the derivation applies to the programme desk's agenda: which umbrella event an item is part of, and kinds the desk's own labels do not give. Each rule names its reason.

part_of.why: Every item of the official programme is part of the summit.
Listed on Portugal Tech Week's own site as one of its events.

kind.why: Portugal Tech Week is a ten-day umbrella of events (6 to 15 November), not one event.
